question: "Ambubachi Mela" is associated with which of the following state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​Ambubachi Mela:

 
 
• It is celebrated at Kamakhya Temple, Assam in June__.
 
• It is the belief that Kamakhya embodies the mother cult, the Shakti.
 
• The meaning of Ambubachi is spoken with water.
 
• Ambubachi Mela is a four-day festival to mark the annual menstruation of the goddess at Kamakhya temple in Guwahati.
 
• Ambubachi Mela is one of the biggest congregations in eastern India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Other fairs and festival of Assam: Bihu Festival, Me-Dum-Me-Phi, Majuli Festival, Dehing Patkai Festival, Kaziranga Elephant Festival and Ali Ai Ligang Festival. 

 
• Kamakhya Temple, Assam

 
 
• It is situated on the banks of Brahmaputra river on top of Nilachal hill.
 
• Kamakhya is one of the sacred sites for the followers of the 51 Shakti Peethas or Shakti Panth, each of which represents a body part of Sati, the companion of Lord Shiva.
